# Lyrion display font

`standard.2.font.bmp` is the big-line font of the Squeezebox / Transporter displays, from Lyrion Music Server's `Graphics` folder
(https://github.com/LMS-Community/slimserver, originally Slim Devices). Used in Transporter mode with the Lyrion maintainers' blessing (Michael Herger, Nov 2026).

`tools/lyrion_font.py` turns it into `ui/src/parts/lyrionFont.ts`.
